# Gut Save

> Gut Save is a Digestive Health Supplement. Gut Save is a natural digestive health formula marketed as the first and only product designed to target what the brand calls the real root cause of bloating, constipation and general digestive discomfort. Rather than offering only fast, temporary relief, the formula is positioned around supporting healthier digestion from the inside so that gas, heaviness and irregular bowel movements become less frequent over time. It is sold as a daily-use supplement in capsule form through its official website, typically in multi-bottle bundles for people who want to commit to a longer stretch of consistent use.
